entities.name: Jimena Cedrés

entities.summary: María Jimena Cedrés Lobbosco is an Argentine field hockey player. At the 2014 Champions Trophy she won her first gold medal with the Argentina national team in an international tournament. Jimena also won the 2014–2015 World League and the 2016 Champions Trophy.
